summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Openspace Agency OS. 30/30 backend pytest tests passed including auth, RBAC, jobs CRUD, invoices, content/timelogs/approvals, notifications, and all 9 AI-powered endpoints (parse-brief, draft-reply, create-job-from-brief, kpi-coaching, team-review, reports-insights, sop-generate, assistant, job-help). Frontend verified across login, manager dashboard (4 stat cards + brand health + workload + finance), sidebar (15 links for manager, 12 for arjun with Smart Inbox/Invoices/Reports correctly hidden), Jobs table (13 rows, Priya filter narrows to 7), Job Detail modal (5 workflow stages, status/progress/comment/AI-help controls), Board (5 kanban columns, 13 cards), KPI (SVG rings render), Vibes, Reports, Invoices, Inbox with full AI brief modal (Claude returned complete PARTIAL brief with primary team, deliverables, workload warning, delegation plan, and missing info sections).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py assignee filter converts 'yusuf' to 'u_yusuf' — this branch is redundant since same logic is applied unconditionally via f'u_{assignee}'. Minor cleanup.

seed_data.py always re-hashes bcrypt on every module import (module-level _hash calls in USERS list). Adds ~1s of CPU on startup even when DB already seeded. Consider deferring hashing into seed_if_empty.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup')/('shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager (informational, still works).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a few TEST_-prefixed artifacts (TEST_AI_Job job, TEST_inv invoice marked paid, TEST_topic content post, TEST_comment on OS-001). These are additive and do not interfere with the 12 seed jobs / 6 seed invoices.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 30 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass end-to-end in ~135s (AI calls dominate). Correct frontend testids: nav-<lowercase> for sidebar links (nav-jobs, nav-inbox, nav-invoices, nav-reports, nav-board, nav-kpi, nav-vibes etc.), team-filter-<short> for Jobs page team pills (e.g. team-filter-priya, NOT team-filter-u_priya), job-modal for job detail (not job-detail-modal), col-<key> for board columns, card-OS-xxx for kanban cards, workflow-stage-<name> for the 5 workflow stages. Inbox AI-brief modal takes ~15-25s for Claude to respond; wait selector [data-testid="brief-status"] with 45s timeout.
